rows.en: Clovis: "Hey, that mech..."
Fain: "That's... Ragrade!"
Celica: "Art Wesper Unit One, 'Ragrade.'
Then it's... Lord Chromehearts's Armored Mech!"
Fain: "Yes! Lord Reduce, the 'Silver Knight'!
He's come back from Limberg in his country's hour of need!
Ghh, that's just like him! Now that's a man!!"
Celica: "Who's he fighting?!"
Miyasco: "Um, um... I've got it!
Zigrim forces.
The mechs are... Deck Bustite and Granbide...
G-Griol!!"
Celica: "Griol? That's their commander's mech!"
Ymir: "A unit allowed to operate independently...
They seem to be elite troops."
Arthur: "Or perhaps a special-duty unit."
Touya: "...Hey, who's Reduce?"
Arthur: "Huh? Oh... He, like Tyron,
is one of York's Three Sword Knights, and the foremost among them.
He was invited to Limberg two years ago
to serve as a military adviser."
Fain: "Known as the 'Silver Knight,' he's one of the continent's
finest swordsmen. His flowing movements and
sharp slashes also earned him the name 'Silver Wolf.'"
Touya: "O-Oh..."
Clovis: "Even he seems to be having a hard time taking on
Zigrim's elite troops all at once.
Anyway, let's help him!"
Ymir: "Yes. First, let's send a message
to the Zigrim forces. I hope they'll withdraw..."
Reduce: "...Stand aside! I cannot afford
to be held up in a place like this!"
???????: "Heh heh heh heh...
I can't do that.
Taking you down is my job."
Zigrim Soldier A: "C-Captain! Our objective is..."
???????: "Shut up... Taking the head of a Three Sword Knight
will raise my standing."
Zigrim Soldier A: "But..."
???????: "...Would you rather I killed you here,
or you were court-martialed for insubordination
against your superior officer? Which would you prefer?"
Zigrim Soldier A: "...I spoke out of turn..."
Reduce: "...Then I have no choice.
I'll show you that the name 'Silver Wolf' isn't just for show."
???????: "Hah! The age of honing your individual skills
like that is over!
The age of you knights!
I, the great Steinies Falmore,
will prove that combat always has new methods
being devised."
Reduce: "I see. Then try out
this way of fighting you speak of."
Ymir: "To the Zigrim forces.
This is territory under York's rule.
Your actions constitute an act of invasion in violation
of international treaties. Lay down your arms and withdraw immediately.
I repeat.
Lay down your arms and withdraw immediately."
Steinies: "What? Where's that coming from?!"
Zigrim Soldier B: "Captain! There's nothing on the radar!"
Zigrim Soldier C: "Transmission source located! Th-This is..."
Steinies: "What is it?"
Zigrim Soldier C: "The transmission is coming from... six ris, four o'clock,
range one hundred, altitude eighty!"
Steinies: "What?! I don't see anything there..."
Celica: "Shouldn't we turn off the optical cloaking?"
Ymir: "Oh, right. Please do."
Zigrim Soldier A: "A-A battleship...!"
Reduce: "That's... Liebhofen!
Why? Why is it here...? Don't tell me..."
Steinies: "A new Agarthian weapon?
No, that can't be... Wait, could it be...
Heh heh heh... I see. So that's it!"
Ymir: "We have no intention of fighting.
Your actions will not be entered into the official record.
So please withdraw."
Steinies: "I really am lucky.
If I bring down that big thing, that nag Fores
won't be my boss anymore..."
Ymir: "I repeat..."
Steinies: "...I can't do that."
Ymir: "What?!"
Zigrim Soldier A: "Captain?!"
Steinies: "If I let Reduce escape here,
it'll encourage the malcontents.
No, he'll become their core and turn his fangs on Zigrim.
And what's inside that big thing
is definitely Spirit Mechs. They probably escaped.
If the Spirit Mechs come out here, we can capture them.
We can also use the fact that they fought to threaten Agarthia
and those Holy Land people.
In other words, I've got no reason to withdraw.
Come on, then. I'll tell everyone
that Spirit Mechs are just weapons, too."
Celica: "...He's seen through us.
He knows that if we fight now, we'll cause trouble for my brother, who pushed through the Spirit Mech Development Project,
and even Lady Ivel in the Holy Land..."
Touya: "Hey, don't tell me you're going to abandon him."
Ymir: "But..."
Reduce: "Can you hear me?! I'll be all right!
Leave this airspace!"
Steinies: "Is that wise? Your mech
can't use its full strength after that forced march, can it?
Heh heh heh. Well, I don't mind, either way."
Yamato: "H-Hey, Touya..."
Insist on launching.
Stay silent.
Touya: "What matters is now, not what comes later! How can we leave him to die
and save the world by doing that?!
One life doesn't weigh more or less than another!
Every life is irreplaceable!!"
Fain: "Yes! Touya's right!
Princess, let's fight!"
Celica: "The weight of a life... All right.
Prepare the Spirit Mechs to launch!"
Ymir: "Celica..."
Celica: "It's all right. I'm sure my brother will understand."
Ymir: "..."
Miyasco: "Ymir."
Derock: "What will be, will be."
Ymir: "...Miyasco, hurry with the terrain data analysis.
Derock, monitor the surrounding contacts and handle area isolation.
I'll handle the Zigrim Armored Mechs.
Let's send as much data as possible to the Spirit Mechs."
Miyasco: "Understood!"
Derock: "Leave it to me."
Celica: "...Thank you."
Ymir: "This is the only way we can help, though."
Celica: "Not at all. I couldn't ask for better support.
All right, I'll help, too."
Fain: "Hey! Why are you keeping quiet?!
Don't tell me you, too..."
Arthur: "...I think Touya is making the right decision.
Our purpose isn't to fight."
Fain: "Even you, Arthur..."
Arthur: "But there are times when we must act, even if the path is thorny.
I believe now is such a time."
Clovis: "You're unusually keen."
Arthur: "I know the history of oppression.
We can't let the flame of liberation go out."
Celica: "...A time to act...
Maybe you're right. All right. Prepare the Spirit Mechs to launch!"
Ymir: "Celica..."
Celica: "It's all right. I'm sure my brother will understand."
Ymir: "..."
Miyasco: "Ymir."
Derock: "What will be, will be."
Ymir: "...Miyasco, hurry with the terrain data analysis.
Derock, monitor the surrounding contacts and handle area isolation.
I'll handle the Zigrim Armored Mechs.
Let's send as much data as possible to the Spirit Mechs."
Miyasco: "Understood!"
Derock: "Leave it to me."
Celica: "...Thank you."
Ymir: "This is the only way we can help, though."
Celica: "Not at all. I couldn't ask for better support.
All right, I'll help, too."
Yamato: "Ai isn't coming out."
Arthur: "We're up against a powerful enemy.
Let's focus on what's in front of us for now."
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... So you've made up your minds...
Now I've got more to enjoy."
Zigrim Soldier B: "Captain, the space within a radius of four hundred leek, six hundred meters,
has been cut off from the outside!"
Zigrim Soldier C: "We can't transmit video like this!"
Steinies: "Tch... Clever little bastards...
For now, just record it."
Zigrim Soldier C: "Yes, sir!"
Reduce: "...I'm sorry. Thank you for your help."
Clovis: "For now, it's dangerous to fight alone.
Join up with us."
Reduce: "Understood."
Steinies: "I won't let that happen. Reduce,
you're going to become another achievement for me!"
Reduce: "..."
Clovis: "We can't afford to fight separately this time, either.
Touya, you take command."
Touya: "Are you sure I should?"
Arthur: "I'm counting on you."
Touya: "...All right. Let's go!"
Touya: "Ai..."
Clovis: "Have you found your answer?"
Ai: "Pretty much. I'm not a kid anymore, and moping around
won't change anything... I'm sure she's alive.
She's definitely alive... I've decided to believe that."
Arthur: "That's admirable."
Ai: "...And with that, Ai is back!
I'm counting on your orders!"
Yamato: "...? This feeling..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Yamato: "Yes... There's no mistake.
Touya, it's Queen Alforinya's reading!"
Touya: "Wh-What do you mean?"
Yamato: "Look, over there!"
Touya: "That's..."
Yamato: "Checking the data. The ship's registry is... York!
It really is the princess! She's alive!"
Steinies: "...? What is it?"
Steinies: "That's... I see. They escaped...
Heh heh heh... I really am lucky..."
Reduce: "?! Escaping...? No...
!! Th-That's... Her Majesty?!"
Touya: "Yamato, can't you contact them?!"
Yamato: "I'm trying, but there's no response!
Maybe their equipment's broken..."
Reduce: "Your Majesty!"
Celica: "That's... Zaxas?"
Fain: "Master?! But... The mech's a different color..."
Reduce: "Prince Cain!"
Ymir: "Don't tell me... Prince Cain?"
Fain: "Cain...? That Prince Cain?!
From Limberg?!"
Cain: "Hello, Celica. It's been a while.
Is Tix well?"
Celica: "Cain?! Is it really you?!
Where on earth have you been all this time...?"
Cain: "We'll talk later. First, the enemy in front of us."
Steinies: "Limberg's Black Prince...
Heh heh heh. Another achievement's come my way.
With the way things are now, there won't be a problem if I kill you."
Cain: "...I'd like to take you on,
but I'll pass today.
Escorting these people is more important."
Steinies: "...Tch. Smug bastard...
What you want has nothing to do with me."
Cain: "Heh heh heh. I'll warn you, I'm strong."
Steinies: "Then I'll teach you there's someone stronger."
Cain: "...Oh?"
Reduce: "...Hm."
Zigrim Soldier B: "Reduce, the Silver Knight!
Care to cross blades?!"
Reduce: "Pointless conflict isn't what I want.
I appreciate the offer, but I have no time for you."
Zigrim Soldier B: "Hmph! Even if you don't,
I'm coming at you anyway."
Reduce: "You seem to have mistaken recklessness for courage...
It can't be helped... If you insist, I'll show you
my secret technique!"
Zigrim Soldier B: "Th-This is... The power of the Three Sword Knights...
S-So strong..."
Steinies: "...Idiot."
Fain: "A-Amazing!"
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... This is fun. This is really
fun!! It's been a long time since I've felt like this!"
Zigrim Soldier A: "Captain! It's dangerous to continue!
Let me..."
Steinies: "Don't overstep your place!
Stay the hell out of it!"
Zigrim Soldier A: "Captain! Further attacks
are pointless! Have you forgotten that your mech is paid for
with the people's hard-earned taxes?!"
Steinies: "...Oh? Are you questioning me?
You're an eyesore..."
Zigrim Soldier A: "I'm prepared to face punishment!"
Steinies: "..."
Zigrim Soldier A: "..."
Steinies: "........Heh heh heh... Fine...
I'll withdraw..."
Zigrim Soldier A: "Yes, sir! Thank you!"
Steinies: "No nagging pests around. Now I can fight
to my heart's cont... Hm? What? Output is dropping?
Those maintenance bastards..."
Touya: "He stopped moving?"
Yamato: "Here's our chance!"
Steinies: "...Tch."
Yamato: "...Oh, he ran away..."
Ymir: "It looks like it's over for now..."
Miyasco: "Oh, Reduce is requesting
permission to land."
Celica: "Have him enter Hangar One."
Miyasco: "Understood."
Steinies: "I-Impossible... Me...
Tch. I'm getting out!"
Touya: "You seem to be all right."
Reduce: "Yes. Thank you."
Touya: "That mech doesn't seem to be in good shape."
Reduce: "Oh...? You noticed.
You're right. There's damage throughout the interior.
But with them pursuing me this far, escape is difficult.
I'm sorry to ask, but will you help?"
Touya: "I'd help even if you refused."
Reduce: "Heh... Those are reassuring words."
Touya: "Heh."
Reduce: "...Then I cannot leave everything to you, either.
Do not underestimate that Griol's performance.
If you're not careful, it'll be you who gets beaten."
Touya: "Yeah, got it. Then I'm counting on you!"
Reduce: "Understood."
Touya: "Finally took him down..."
Celica: "That's amazing! Right?"
Ymir: "Yes. To already be able to pilot it that well..."
Ymir: "It looks like it's over for now..."
Miyasco: "Oh, Reduce is requesting
permission to land."
Celica: "Have him enter Hangar One."
Miyasco: "Understood."

Reduce: "Ghh..."
Touya: "Don't push yourself! Leave the rest to us!"
Reduce: "...I'm sorry."
Miyasco: "...Oh, heat source confirmed!
I believe it's a small craft."
Celica: "Where is the ship from?"
Miyasco: "U-Um... This is..."
Ymir: "What's wrong?
Oh, its registry is York?! It's a ship of the Istarsh royal family!"
Celica: "What?! Then they escaped safely?!
Miyasco, can you open a channel?"
Miyasco: "Y-Yes... Huh? No, there's no
response. I believe their communications link
is probably down."
Celica: "...Could it be a trap? No. They couldn't have predicted we'd be here.
That possibility is low.
Lower Liebhofen and let's meet up."
Baren: "...Lowering Liebhofen."
Celica: "How's it going?"
Miyasco: "We'll finish bringing them into the hangar shortly."
Ymir: "What?!"
Derock: "It's an Armored Mech. I'll put the image through now."
Celica: "That's... Zaxas?!
Why is Major Rest's mech here...?"
Miyasco: "It isn't his. I believe it's another mech of the same model."
Ymir: "Huh? Zaxas was made exclusively for Major Rest,
wasn't it?"
Celica: "...Oh, now that I think about it, I heard that a completed Zaxas
was given to Cain for his birthday."
Miyasco: "Cain...? That Prince Cain?!
Limberg's second prince?!"
Miyasco: "Oh, an incoming transmission! Opening the channel!"
Cain: "Hello, Celica.
It's been a while. Is Tix well?"
Celica: "Cain! Where on earth have you been all this time...?"
Cain: "We'll talk later.
Could I have permission to land, too?"
Celica: "...All right. Ymir, that's fine, isn't it?"
Ymir: "Y-Yes."
Cain: "Then I'll see you later."
Mechanic A: "All right, secure the hull!"
Mechanic D: "...Secured."
Mechanic B: "Opening the hatch!"
Ai: "Alforina!"
Alforina: "..."
Oswald: "Everyone, it's been some time."
Ai: "Alforina?!"
Alforina: "..."
Oswald: "I'm sorry.
Could you take Her Majesty to the infirmary?"
Ai: "Hey, what on earth did you...?"
Gabon: "...Her pulse... Normal.
All right, everyone, move. Miyasco, we're taking her to the infirmary!"
Miyasco: "Y-Yes!"
Ai: "I-I'm coming, too!"
Gabon: "...All right. Come along."
Oswald: "Whew... That's a relief."
Fain: "...Hey, you didn't do anything strange
to Her Majesty, did you...?"
Fain: "Oww... Princess, a fist hurts..."
Celica: "What are you saying, right out of nowhere?!"
Fain: "B-But..."
Oswald: "No, no, it's quite all right.
I don't know what you think of me,
but I am a loyal servant of York and Her Majesty.
How could I possibly do something like that?
Please, rest assured..."
Celica: "...Could you explain
what happened?"
Oswald: "Of course. As you know, Flamuelk Castle
has fallen.
Her Majesty insisted on staying to the end,
but I judged that protecting her
was vital for York's future. It was a little rough,
but I put her to sleep and escaped the castle."
Reduce: "Lord Exogilm, what about the others?"
Oswald: "Ah, Lord Reduce. I'm glad you're safe.
...Unfortunately, we were the only ones who escaped."
Fain: "What?! Th-Then Lord Tyron?!"
Oswald: "He stayed behind to let us escape.
He probably..."
Reduce: "You're saying he died in battle?!"
Oswald: "Well... After we escaped,
the full-scale bombardment began..."
Reduce: "...That's just like him...
Does Her Majesty know?"
Oswald: "No. But she also intended to share the castle's fate.
I believe she'll realize it soon enough..."
Reduce: "I... see..."
Cain: "Anyway, you're safe. That's good, isn't it?"
Oswald: "!!"
Arthur: "...Do you know each other?"
Oswald: "W-Well..."
Cain: "We've never met before. Right?"
Oswald: "Th-That's right. Today is the first time."
Arthur: "..."
Celica: "Cain!"
Cain: "Hello. It's been a while, Celica."
Celica: "...You've gotten a little sturdier."
Cain: "Well, it's been three years.
Even I grow up."
Celica: "What on earth have you been doing?
Limberg reported your return three years ago,
so I knew you were safe. But then you suddenly disappeared...
You don't have much sense of being a prince."
Cain: "Ha ha ha. You're harsh.
But I'm not a prince anymore."
Celica: "Huh?"
Cain: "I ran away from home two years ago.
Besides, Father meant to choose my older brother as his successor,
and it wasn't a comfortable place for me."
Celica: "Cain... You've changed somehow."
Cain: "No. I've gotten stronger.
I left the country because I was sure I could manage on my own.
I was on a journey of training to improve myself even further,
when I heard explosions. I came to look, and there you were,
fighting. That's how it happened."
Fain: "Such an admirable attitude at your age!
I, Fain Jin Barion, am impressed!"
Celica: "...You and Cain are only two years apart, you know."
Fain: "Huh? Is he?
I thought he was much younger..."
Cain: "..."
Fain: "I-I'm joking.
Please don't look at me like that..."
Oswald: "W-Well, I'll take my leave.
I'm worried about Her Majesty..."
Fain: "Oh! Then I'll show you the way!"
Reduce: "This may be a selfish request,
but could you take us straight to Belnea Fort on the border?"
Ymir: "Belnea Fort... If I remember correctly..."
Reduce: "Yes. Lord Garyud and his daughter,
Ciel, a knight like myself, are there."
Reduce: "I don't think it will fall easily,
but a battle of attrition will inevitably be hard on them.
Losing those two would be
a serious blow to our country. More importantly, Her Majesty
wouldn't want that, either."
Ymir: "I'm in favor, but..."
Celica: "Yes. Given the situation, every moment counts.
Let's head there at once."
Cain: "...Wait a moment. You have a point,
but shouldn't we secure Queen Alforina's safety first,
and then go?
If you like, I can suggest a good place."
Arthur: "No, I don't think that will be necessary.
I'm sure Reduce considered that, too.
If he deliberately didn't mention it, perhaps he judged
that she'd be safer aboard this ship."
Reduce: "Yes. Liebhofen should be sturdier
than a mediocre fortress.
In our present situation, I judged that only the Holy Land could compare."
Cain: "...I see."
Arthur: "We appreciate your offer, Your Highness,
but there's Belnea Fort to consider, too.
I believe heading there directly is the right decision."
Cain: "..."
Arthur: "..."
Yamato: 'H-Hey, do those two not get along?'
Touya: 'Don't ask me.'
Cain: "...Heh. I see.
So there was no need for me to interfere."
Celica: "Cain..."
Cain: "It isn't exactly in exchange,
but I'd like to join the battle at that fort, too.
Having one more ally would help, wouldn't it?"
Celica: "Are you sure?"
Cain: "Of course. It'll also be an apology for three years ago.
Then I'll be in your care for a little while."
Yamato: "Oh, he left..."
Celica: "...Arthur, hold on!
Wasn't that a bit much?"
Ymir: "Yes. What's gotten into you?
That wasn't like you."
Clovis: "...The prince and Oswald?"
Arthur: "You noticed?"
Clovis: "No. I just thought so from your attitude."
Arthur: "Those two have met before.
I don't know why they have to lie about it,
but I think we need to be careful.
Especially with Prince Cain."
Celica: "You're overthinking it.
Besides, he helped us, didn't he?
Isn't it a little cruel to suspect him from the start?"
Celica: "Even if that were true, isn't it a little cruel
to suspect him just for that?"
Arthur: "I'm sorry. But..."
Ymir: "Speculation won't get us anywhere.
Besides, Belnea Fort takes priority right now.
Let's focus on rescuing Lord Garyud and Ciel first."
Arthur: "...You're right."
Touya: "Hey, don't we need to go
to that Holy Land place?"
Celica: "After that battle, the records of combat against Spirit Mechs
are now known to the Zigrim army.
If we leave it at that, we've simply used force.
Then we should help liberate York
and win over as much public opinion as we can."
Yamato: "...Lady Celica, did you decide to help
after calculating all that?"
Celica: "That wasn't the only reason."
Yamato: "You're amazing."
Celica: "Thank you.
Now, you should all get some rest.
You'll probably have to work even harder next time."
Touya: "Yeah, you're right."
Arthur: "Touya. There's a small favor I'd like to ask."
Touya: "Hm?"
Arthur: "It's about Prince Cain. There's something
that keeps bothering me. I'm sorry to ask,
but could you discreetly keep an eye on his movements?"
Touya: "Hey..."
Arthur: "He'd be wary of me or Clovis.
But you've only recently arrived here,
so it would be easier for you to make an excuse.
I'm not asking you to stake him out.
Just pay attention to what he does when you happen to see him."
All right. I'll try to be discreet.
I don't approve of that sort of thing.
Arthur: "Thank you."
Touya: "...But aren't you worrying too much?"
Arthur: "Yes. I hope my fears are groundless."
Arthur: "I see. All right.
I'm sorry I asked so much of you."
Alforina: "Ugh... Where... am I...?
Alforina: "I'm... alive..."
Ai: "Waaaaah! Thank goodness! You're alive!"
Alforina: "A-Ai...?
Heh heh heh. That... hurts..."
Ai: "Oh, s-sorry! Are you all right?"
Alforina: "Heh heh. I'm all right.
...Could we be aboard Liebhofen?"
Ai: "Y-Yes. That's right.
They said he used medicine to put you to sleep and escaped the castle."
Alforina: "I... see... Lord Exogilm.
Oh, what about the others?!"
Miyasco: "It seems only Lady Alforina and
Lord Exogilm escaped.
Reduce is aboard this ship, too."
Alforina: "I see. Reduce...
Then Tyron..."
Ai: "Alforina..."
Gabon: "Well, we'll take our leave.
Her Majesty should get plenty of sleep. All right?"
Alforina: "Yes... Thank you."
Gabon: "Then, Ai, I'm leaving the rest to you."
Ai: "Huh? Y-Yeah..."
Miyasco: "We'll take our leave."
Alforina: "..."
Ai: "Ha ha ha... There was so much I wanted to tell you,
but it's strange. Nothing will come out..."
Alforina: "Ai... I'm sorry
for making you worry."
Ai: "No! I'm just glad you're safe. When I heard the castle
had fallen, I thought my heart would stop.
Just having you here, safe, is enough."
Alforina: "Heh heh..."
Ai: "...Oh! That's right!
Hey, do you want something sweet?"
Alforina: "Huh?"
Ai: "Hey, don't you?"
Alforina: "...Yes. I'd really like that."
Ai: "All right! Then I'll make you my very own
special cookies!
Oh, but do we have the ingredients...?"
Alforina: "If it's something you've made, Ai,
I'd be delighted to have it."
Ai: "R-Really? Then wait just a moment!
I'll make them right away!"
Alforina: "Heh heh heh."
Ai: "Oh, and you have to stay in bed!
You need to rest and get your strength back now."
Alforina: "Yes. I understand."
Ai: "Good, good. You absolutely have to!"
Alforina: "Yes."
Ai: "See you!"
Alforina: "...Thank you, Ai."

Growster: "Hmph! Of course!

how's the production line?"

Growster: "Heh heh heh... Once that's finished...

and winning over the elector cities that hold the right to elect."

will be less than a third... Victory is assured."

I'd like you to put it on hold..."

...Is that it?"
Bio: "No, no, not at all.
I came purely to discuss business."
Growster: "Hmph! I don't care if you tell anyone.
Besides, the plan to win them over
was that useless fool's idea.
More importantly, what would you gain by doing that?
I see nothing but losses..."
Bio: "That's also a trade secret.
But I'll just say that money isn't the only
kind of profit."

We've got enough new models anyway.
I'll put you in my debt."
Bio: "In your debt...? All right.
Then I leave it in your hands."
